key.name: start-paused
key.description: Start the extension in paused state.

key.name: refresh-interval-ms
key.description: How often to update panel and monitors (500-5000ms).

key.name: decimal-precision
key.description: Number of decimal places for rate display.

key.name: panel-display-mode
key.description: Display mode: down-up, compact, down-only, up-only, total-only.

key.name: auto-detect-interfaces
key.description: Automatically detect active interfaces.

key.name: included-interfaces
key.description: List of interfaces to monitor when auto-detect is off.

key.name: excluded-interfaces
key.description: List of interfaces to exclude from monitoring.

key.name: ignore-loopback
key.description: Ignore loopback interface (lo).

key.name: ignore-virtual
key.description: Ignore virtual interfaces (docker, veth, br-, etc.).

key.name: enable-process-monitor
key.description: Track bandwidth usage per application or process.

key.name: process-grouping-mode
key.description: Grouping mode: disabled, smart, aggressive.

key.name: ignored-processes
key.description: List of process names to ignore in per-app view.

key.name: top-process-count
key.description: Number of top processes to show in popup.

key.name: persistence-enabled
key.description: Save usage history to disk.

key.name: retention-days
key.description: Number of days to keep historical data.

key.name: daily-cap-bytes
key.description: Daily data cap threshold (0 = disabled).

key.name: monthly-cap-bytes
key.description: Monthly data cap threshold (0 = disabled).

key.name: spike-threshold-bytes-per-sec
key.description: Per-app spike threshold in bytes/sec (0 = disabled).

key.name: notification-cooldown-sec
key.description: Minimum seconds between repeated alerts.

key.name: quiet-hours-enabled
key.description: Suppress notifications during quiet hours.

key.name: quiet-hours-start
key.description: Start time for quiet hours (HH:MM 24h).

key.name: quiet-hours-end
key.description: End time for quiet hours (HH:MM 24h).

key.name: debug-enabled
key.description: Enable verbose logging for troubleshooting.

key.name: show-compact
key.description: Show compact panel indicator.
